title: Anna's Party
text:
Anna has a birthday party on Saturday. She writes invitations for her friends. The invitation says: Come to my house at four o'clock. Anna gives the invitations to her friends at school.

Tom gets an invitation from Anna. He is happy and says yes. He asks his mother for a gift. On Saturday, Tom brings a red book to the party.

questions.text: What does Tom bring to the party?
Why does Tom say yes to the invitation?
options: He wants to go to the party
He is at home on Saturday

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about her party?
options: She is excited and wants her friends to come
She is angry at her friends
She does not want any guests

vocabulary.definition: an event where people meet to have fun
cards or messages that ask people to come to an event
something you give to someone on a special day

paragraph_translations: Anna ma przyjęcie urodzinowe w sobotę. Pisze zaproszenia dla swoich przyjaciół. Zaproszenie mówi: Przyjdź do mojego domu o czwartej. Anna daje zaproszenia swoim przyjaciołom w szkole.
Tom dostaje zaproszenie od Anny. Jest szczęśliwy i mówi tak. Prosi mamę o prezent. W sobotę Tom przynosi na przyjęcie czerwoną książkę.
